scope: CashTokens, political recovery, seasonal rewards; audit only

findings.title: Independent political returns are not recognized without the operator signer
findings.impact: Read-only deployments leave matured escrow/treaty records and locked balance stale despite a payer's independent confirmed refund; BCH itself can still be recovered.
findings.reproduction: Run node var/audit-blockchain/tokens-audit.mjs. With payoutsEnabled:false, reconcile never calls the available refund observer and retains funded status.
findings.cause: A private-signer guard precedes read-only confirmed-spend observation.
findings.recommendation: Separate observation/reconciliation from signing availability and add a read-only restart integration test.

findings.title: Valid NFT ownership becomes unresolved at traversal and address-history bounds
findings.impact: Current-holder queries can stop resolving valid transferable proof collectibles; token spendability and off-chain game control are unaffected.
findings.reproduction: Run node var/audit-blockchain/tokens-audit.mjs. Fifteen valid synthetic transfers resolve; sixteen return traversal-limit. A spender after 256 unrelated history entries is not reached.
findings.cause: Fixed traversal/history bounds without continuation or a persisted verified head.
findings.recommendation: Use bounded continuation/pagination with a verified outpoint checkpoint; retain uncertainty when unverified.
